MilciFenin f1-Avc NYAi1LCx ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT .29 AGREEMENT made as of this 2 day of March, 2005 (this “Agreement"), by                Avenue, Suite 900, New York, New York 10170 ("NRP"). RECITALS: A.NRP is the current owner in fee simple of that parcel of real estate located at and having an address of 771-773 Eighth Avenue, New York, New York,as more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Land"), together with the existing building located thereon (the “Existing Building"). B.Immediately following the execution of this Agreement, through a series of deed transfers (all to be dated as of the date hereof) (collectively, the “Deed Transfers"), NRP will convey (or cause to be conveyed) to Partnership 93, L.P., a Delaware limited partnership, 771 Eighth Avenue, LLC, a New York limited liability company, and Gould 8th Avenue LLC, a New York limited liability company (collectively,“FB"), fee simple in and to that certain parcel of real estate more particularly described on Exhibit A-1 annexed hereto and made a part hereof (as hereinafter defined). C. NRP will retain ownership of that certain parcel of real estate comprising a volume of space, as more particularly described on Exhibit A-2 annexed hereto and made a part hereof, and the Excess Development Rights (hereinafter defined) and Additional Excess thereof (collectively, the“Air Parcel"). D. As used herein, the owner or owners of the Land Parcel and their successors and/or assigns shall be referred to as the “LP Owner,” and the owner or owners of the Air Parcel Deed Transfers, FB shall be deemed to be the LP Owner for all purposes of this Agreement and at the request of the AP Owner,FB shall deliver a confirmation (in recordable form) acknowledging, and agreeing to be bound by, the terms and provisions of this Agreement, and a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions with respect to the Combined Zoning Lot. E. As used herein, the term “Excess Development Rights" shall mean all of the Floor Area Development Rights (hereinafter defined) appurtenant or pertaining to the Land or any portion thereof in excess of the following: (i) the Floor Area Development Rights used by the Existing Building as it exists on the date hereof, as depicted on the survey annexed hereto as Rights that may be used by the Future Construction (as hereinafter defined) that is undertaken in compliance with this Agreement. F.As used herein, the term “Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean certain rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution (hereinafter defined), which are - 1 - HFNY2:#807915v.8#03543-0060 03/24/2005

appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structureswitha totalFloorArea(assuchtermisdefinedin theZoningResolution)determined (i)by multiplying the area of the zoninglot by the maximum allowableFloorArea Ratio(as suchtermisdefinedintheZoningResolution)for structures inthezoningdistrict or districts in which such zoning lot is located, and (i) any buik and density rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution and which may be authorized to be developed by the appropriate agency of the City of NewYorkfromtime to time. G. As used herein, the term “Additional Excess Development Rights” shall mean the Land or any portion thereof created, authorized or arising on or after the date hereof by any means, including, but not limited to, a modification of or amendment to the Zoning Resolution or other change in existing law, or an upward revision by the City of NewYork of the allowable shall be collectively referred to herein as the“Development Rights". H. Accordingly, pursuant to procedures currently available under the Zoning Resolution, the AP Owner may from time to time transfer some or all of the Development Rights              Developer's Land"). 1.The AP Owner and LP Owner wish to merge the Air Parcel and Land Parcel into a single “zoning lot,”as such term is defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York,effective December 15,1961 (as amended to the date hereof, the“Zoning Resolution") (such single zoning lot being herein referred to as the “Combined Zoning Lot"), and to enter into this Agreement in order to establish certain rights of and privileges to the AP Ownerwithrespect totheCombined ZoningLot. J. Accordingly, a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration") dated the date hereof, with respect to the Combined Zoning Lot, will be submitted contemporaneously herewith for recording in the New York County Office of the Register of The City of New York (the “Register's Office"). K. The Air Parcel is contiguous with the Land Parcel for at least ten (10) linear feet, and theAirParcel and theLandParcel are allwithin a singleblock. NOW, THEREFORE, the parties agrees as follows: ARTICLEI Section 1.1The AP Owner hereby retains all of the Development Rights and the right to use or convey all or any portion of the Development Rights. Accordingly, neither the LP Owner nor any person or entity claiming by, under or through the LP Owner shall have any right, title or interest in or to the Development Rights. -2- HFNY2: #807915 v.8 #03543-0060 03/24/2005
